review_notes: 8 modules audited, 1285 total lines, 10 eliminable lines (0.8%). Below the 25-line threshold.
Q1 (stdlib/dep already solves): _OtlpHandler uses stdlib http.server — appropriate. OTLP protobuf deserialization uses opentelemetry-proto dep — correct.
Q2 (library could solve): No library reduces lines here. A full OTEL collector would be heavier. The lightweight protobuf attribute unwrapping is intrinsic to the AnyValue wrapper.
Q3 violations: GET /health (8L) is dead — nobody calls it. _get_span_type fallback (2L) is dead code path.
Dockerfile.sandbox already installs @opentelemetry/sdk-node + related packages (line 11). Requirement met.
opencode.json config via to_opencode_json uses experimental.openTelemetry flag. OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT injected as env var in dispatch.py:149. Both requirements met.

Best-effort error handling: _handle_traces wraps in try/except (otel_receiver.py:76-79). Invalid protobuf logged and swallowed. Test coverage: test_invalid_payload_does_not_crash and test_empty_body_does_not_crash.
